body:
Minor issue, for the options we keep the `style` and `disabled` as the bottom two rows of the table, e.g:
```
| `symbol`         | `"☸ "`        | The symbol used before displaying the Cluster info. |
| `show_context`   | `true`        | Should context name be shown?                       |
| `show_namespace` | `true`        | Should namespace name be shown?                     |
| `style`          | `"bold blue"` | The style for the module.                           |
| `disabled`       | `true`        | Disables the `kubernetes` module                    |
```

The tests are currently failing because [Clippy](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-clippy) doesn't like this line. I think the following should fix it.
```suggestion
                        &config.namespace.with_value(kube_ns.to_string()),
```
